newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: No ruling on Community Bank - S.Africa Reserve Bank.
newsitem.headline: No ruling on Community Bank - S.Africa Reserve Bank.

text.p: South Africa's Reserve Bank said on Thursday no final decision had been taken on the future of the beleagured Community Bank despite media speculation that it would cease operations.

"Having regard to public policy considerations and the time-consuming nature of the issues involved, no final decision with regard to the future of Community Bank has yet been taken," the Reserve Bank said in a statement.
The Reserve Bank said "it remains the main objective of the the Department of Finance and the Office for Banks, as far as possible, to ensure the continued existence of Community Bank."
Business Day newspaper reported on Thursday that Community Bank was expected to begin closing at the end of this month and members of staff had been issued with retrenchment letters.
The Reserve Bank said Community Bank, which was placed under curatorship in May, had been forced to downsize due to high operational costs.

In July curator Stewart Patterson recommended to Finance Minister Trevor Manuel and the Reserve Bank that Community Bank merge with the South African Housing Trust and one other government-backed institution.

However, it was understood that lengthy delays in receiving a final decision from government on the bank's future subsequently rendered the merger unworkable as the trust was forced to continue with its own plans, the newspaper report said.
